guarantees.claim: For i=0..5, a prim_buf instance is generated connecting c[i][1:0] to its in_i and driving c_buf[i][1:0] from its out_o.

assumptions.claim: The instantiated prim_buf module (with default parameters) must provide the expected signal buffering (e.g., combinational or registered) consistent with the masking security intent.
assumptions.cond: when c[i] carries masked secret values
assumptions.risk: If prim_buf is purely combinational and no register stage is inserted elsewhere, glitches on c[i] may couple directly to c_buf[i] and propagate, potentially violating masking assumptions.

uncertain_points.claim: The generated prim_buf instances may be purely combinational (no register stage), which would not add glitch isolation for the masked signal c[i].
uncertain_points.cond: if prim_buf default configuration is a wire-buffer (no flop) and no other register stage exists
uncertain_points.risk: Glitches in masked data could leak through side-channels, weakening the masked S‑box countermeasure.
